subject: Medford-Malden Thanksgiving Football Game
overview: Medford High School played Malden High School in the annual Thanksgiving football game at Fenway Park. Malden defeated Medford by a final score of 34 to 15.

items.title: Pregame and Coin Toss
items.summary: Honorary captains Ron Zambel, Mike Colonna, and George Bob Baker joined the teams on the field, and Malden won the coin toss and elected to receive.

items.title: First Quarter
items.summary: Malden took a 14-0 lead behind a touchdown run by Kevin Exelhom and a fumble recovery return for a touchdown by Felix Acosta.

items.title: Second Quarter
items.summary: Malden extended its lead to 22-0 following a second touchdown carry by Kevin Exelhom and a successful two-point conversion pass to Kyle Paulding.

items.title: Halftime
items.summary: The Malden High School Band performed, and the winning raffle ticket for the Wasabi Fenway Bowl was drawn.

items.title: Second Half
items.summary: Medford answered with touchdowns from Stephens Exeter and Luis Barboza, but Malden pulled away with additional touchdowns by Kevin Exelhom and Davian McGuffey.

items.title: Final Score
items.summary: Malden concluded the game with a 34-15 victory over Medford.
